name: BuiltWith

sources.title: KB: How to Add a Technology to BuiltWith — points to the Technology Suggestion Form at builtwith.com/suggest
Homepage — returned compressed/binary content to the fetcher; site is a web technology profiler, not a launch board

requirements: BuiltWith is not a directory submission site — it profiles what technologies websites use
The free route is the Technology Suggestion Form at https://builtwith.com/suggest to get your product tracked as a detectable technology
Best odds: supply example sites where the technology is already in use, plus detection hints (JS filenames, cookies, meta tags) in the comment box
Check whether the technology is already tracked before suggesting
preparation: A list of live sites already using the technology
Detection signature details — JS paths, cookie names, DNS, HTML markers
Confirmation the tech isn't already in BuiltWith's 126k+ technology database
workflow: Submit the technology with example sites and detection comments
BuiltWith adds technologies 'as a priority'; once tracked, your tech gets a profile page and appears in usage lists of sites running it
watchFor: This only makes sense if the product is itself a website technology (widget, script, SaaS with a detectable footprint) — a pure content/product listing does not exist
Getting tracked requires real deployments — a brand-new product with no installs has nothing to detect
The paid products on the site are lead-generation/list tools, unrelated to getting your tech listed
Homepage serves compressed responses that some fetchers can't decode
countsAsLive: The technology appears in BuiltWith's technology index (e.g. a /t/<tech> or technology profile page) and shows sites detected using it
unknowns: Whether the suggestion form requires an account
Minimum install footprint needed before a technology is tracked
